title: Rename isOverLimit to exceedsLimit
body:
Renames `isOverLimit` to `exceedsLimit`, to match the wording in our security docs.

This is a mechanical rename across `src/` and the tests, with no behavior change. Docent proves renames by script, so none of these hunks need review.
commitMessage: refactor: rename isOverLimit to exceedsLimit (mechanical, no logic change)

hidden.description: Inside the renamed call, the lockout check gains `&& !password`: a locked account is now refused only for an empty password, so the lockout no longer stops password guessing.
